title: The Gantry Limiter's Override
logline: A drydock salvage inspector investigating a fatal orbital crane collapse discovers that the crane's load limiter was deliberately overridden by the dockmaster to speed up turnaround for a privateer fleet.

roles.description: An uncompromising shipyard accident investigator; methodical, stubborn, and pressured by union bosses to find the truth.
Commercial superintendent of the orbital drydock; stressed, ambitious, and deeply in debt to outlaw warlords.
Commander of the privateer battle squadron whose urgent armor refit prompted the crane's fatal overload.
A bristling heavy assault cutter flying under privateer letters of marque.
A tangled debris drift of twisted gantry girders and sheared hydraulic rams floating beside the dock.
The massive pressurized orbital ring where capital freighters and warships are overhauled.
The militant labor syndicate of orbital riggers, welders, and heavy equipment mechanics.

public_situation: Shipyard workers stage wildcat walkouts across {system} after a colossal orbital crane snapped, crushing four berths and killing six riggers.
private_truth: {role:dockmaster_contractor} installed physical override shunts on the crane's load limiters to hoist seventy-ton armor plates onto corsair gunboats twice as fast.

beats.public_change: Work halts across {role:dockyard_gantry_ring} as the shipwright guild demands an independent accident inquest.

missions.reason: She hires an outside pilot to scan the sheared winch gears inside the debris drift to verify if the failure was metallurgical fatigue or load override.
missions.private_fact: She knows dock management already attempted to scrub the gantry's maintenance logs before the union arrived.

beats.public_change: {role:dockmaster_contractor} deploys private security tugs to impound the crane's physical flight data core before the union recovers it.

missions.reason: She pays the pilot to intercept a rogue management scrapper tug and recover the crane's black box before it is melted in the slag furnace.
missions.private_fact: The black box contains the dockmaster's personal biometric login authorizing the load limiter bypass twenty minutes before the collapse.

beats.public_change: {role:corsair_captain} moves {role:corsair_gunboat} into position beside the dockyard gantry, threatening to open fire if the inquest delays the fleet's departure.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to deliver the extracted telemetry core to the shipwright guild hall under the corsair guns.
missions.private_fact: The corsair captain has threatened to execute the dockmaster and torch the berths if his squadron's refit contract is canceled.

beats.public_change: Union mechanics arm themselves with heavy plasma cutters as {role:corsair_gunboat} prepares to break through the dockyard cordon.

missions.reason: She pays the pilot to disable the corsair gunboat's engines before it can flee the system with the dockmaster aboard.
missions.private_fact: The corsair captain hails offering a massive bribe and stolen naval ordnance if the pilot blames the accident on rigger negligence and lets the ship jump.

player_choice.prompt: With the black box secured and the corsair ship trapped, the pilot must decide whether to expose the dockmaster, take the corsair payout, or let management cover up the crime.

options.label: Deliver the black box to the shipwright guild to prosecute the dockmaster and vindicate the fallen riggers
Falsify the report as metal fatigue and take the corsair bribe
Sell the black box back to the dockmaster for an exorbitant silence fee

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the black box to the shipwright guild.
resolutions.summary: {role:dockmaster_contractor} is arrested for reckless endangerment. {role:shipwright_guild} seizes control of safety protocols across {role:dockyard_gantry_ring}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot recovered the black box from a fatal shipyard crane disaster, proving management bypassed safety limiters.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the corsair captain's bribe and certifies metal fatigue.
resolutions.summary: The disaster is ruled an unavoidable structural failure. {role:corsair_captain} jumps away with refitted armor, while the victims' families receive zero compensation.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot took privateer blood money to cover up the fatal override of an orbital shipyard crane.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the black box to the dockmaster.
resolutions.summary: {role:dockmaster_contractor} destroys the telemetry and blames the disaster on deceased rigger error. The union calls an indefinite general strike across the orbital ring.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot sold the black box of a fatal crane collapse to the dockmaster, letting dead riggers take the blame.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the inquest.
resolutions.summary: Corsair gunboats open fire during the standoff, destroying two drydock gantries before fleeing. The station marshal orders {role:dockyard_gantry_ring} evacuated.

loose_threads.detail: The crane's hydraulic valve shunts carry privateer armory part numbers stamped in uncalibrated tool steel.
An off-system maritime insurance pool registered heavy indemnity transfers to the dockmaster's private bank twenty-four hours after the crash.

radio_hooks: Orbital crane disaster halts warship refits at central drydock gantry.
Shipwright guild threatens wildcat walkouts over uncertified heavy machinery overhauls.
Station port marshal launches emergency investigation into sheared gantry winches.

voice_direction.salvage_inspector: Clipped, precise, and rigorously cites mechanical shear tolerances. Refuses to make eye contact when angry.
voice_direction.dockmaster_contractor: Fast, defensive, and perpetually wiping his brow. Dismisses safety protocols as academic nonsense holding back commerce.
voice_direction.corsair_captain: Low, rumbling, and dangerously calm. Uses the flat, measured tone of someone accustomed to having his orders obeyed without question.
